caseNameFull: Edward A. Peters v. Henry L. Ferris & Hunt, Helm, Ferris & Co.
summary: Appeal from the District Court of the United States for the Eastern District of Wisconsin.
attorneys: Mr. William G. Henderson for the appellant. Mr. Philip C. Dyrenforth, Mr. Francis M. Phelps and Mr. George A. Chritton for the appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for the want of jurisdiction upon the authority of Covington v. First National Bank, 185 U. S. 270; Heike v. United States, 217 U. S. 423; United States v. Beatty, 232 U. S. 463; see Alexander v. United States, 201 U. S. 117.
